faqs.a:
Unless otherwise provided by law, all administrative hearings conducted by any officer
               or agency of the city wherein a determination of the rights or responsibilities of
               any person is made, shall be conducted in accordance with the procedure set forth
               in this article. Provided, however, this procedure shall not apply to any hearing
               before the planning commission, the liquor authority, the board of adjustment, or
               the city council pertaining to the consideration or adoption of an ordinance nor to
               any hearing arising from a municipal special improvement district or annexation.
(Code 1981, § 2-137; Ord. No. 3608, §§ 1, 2, 4-3-2003)
